# 📚 Documentation Change Proposal

## Pages and reason
Paths affected, audience and what is incorrect/missing.

## Source of truth
Code, tests, formal algorithm reference or policy supporting the update.

## Proposed change
Summary of text and diagram updates.

## Validation
- [ ] Internal links resolve.
- [ ] Commands match repository files.
- [ ] Implemented and planned behavior are distinguished.
- [ ] No sensitive data or unlicensed assets.

## Review
Owner, date and approval.
